say:0:1830406001:1.text: The painting is falling apart, its canvas split and its colors flaking. Yet the Twilight Village it once captured is still visible—teal rooftops, golden trees, a farmer leading an ox between the fields, and several children racing close behind.
say:0:1830406001:1.source_cn: 一幅破损的画，颜料剥落，画布开裂。但依稀能看出夕染村还...
